title: Knowledge/skills registry UI: add/modify/view knowledge, skills, techstack, domain, MCP
body: Dashboard UI workflow over core/knowledge_registry (/api/knowledge): list/filter by kind/agent; add a knowledge base / skill / techstack / domain / MCP (name, layers, uri/path, source, license, target agents); modify; view usage; show which agents receive it.
